query_params.description: Optional optimistic lock (read from the query string on DELETE); 409 `stale_version` when outdated.

responses.description: No live statutory fee with this identifier (`not_found`).
`stale_version`: `expected_version` is not the row's current version.

description: The DEFAULT quotation validity (`days`, `grace_days`, `effective_from`, `version`) plus every effective window, and `resolved_now` — what a quotation issued now would get (the ACTIVE window containing now with the latest `effective_from`, else the default). All default fields are null and `resolved_now` is null when no policy is configured.

auth.notes: Throttle scope `staff` (1200/min). APIView: no record scope.

description: Creates or updates the DEFAULT policy (creating needs `days`, else 400). When `windows` is sent it **replaces** the window list: upsert by `policy_id`, windows left out become INACTIVE (never deleted). A window must end after it starts (400); duplicate `policy_id` → 400. `expected_version` (the `version` from GET) → 409 `stale_version` when outdated; the example omits it so a fresh environment works.
